interpretation: Includes failed attempts as audit history. Their presence is not evidence of a pass; use the selected successful check/build/comparison receipts and final review. Original absolute paths are provenance, not portable execution instructions.

omission_and_rebuild_notes.baseline_binary: Excluded; rebuild recorded baseline commit with Cargo.lock, compiler/profile/features/command/environment from preserved build receipt. Exact baseline binary hash is retained.
omission_and_rebuild_notes.baseline_source_tree_and_archive: Excluded to avoid nested historical benchmark archives. Recreate the exact recorded source archive with git archive --format=tar BASELINE_COMMIT; verify its recorded SHA-256 before extracting.
omission_and_rebuild_notes.candidate_binary: Excluded; exact candidate compiled source and committed integration fixture are included. Rebuild using Cargo.lock and the selected build receipt's compiler/profile/features/command/environment. Candidate binary hash is verified when packaging and retained in receipts.
omission_and_rebuild_notes.checked_runtime_sources: All passing-check source payloads are included, including Python validator modules and local dependencies omitted from the compiled Rust snapshot. checked_source_members maps every checked original path to its archived member; files already present in bundle are not duplicated.
omission_and_rebuild_notes.committed_integration_fixture: Included in candidate_source/tests/fixtures; this small committed fixture is distinct from the external million-read biological prefixes.
omission_and_rebuild_notes.compiler_and_dependency_caches: Excluded toolchain binaries, Cargo registries, target trees and caches. Installation and build receipts retain versions, hashes and commands; network/cache availability is required to reproduce installation/builds.
omission_and_rebuild_notes.external_biological_fastq_prefixes: Excluded tmp/reads and every external FASTQ input. Prefix hashes, read/base/byte counts, source URLs and restoration receipts remain in bundle/inputs and comparison/freeze.json.
omission_and_rebuild_notes.older_benchmark_archives: Excluded complete previous benchmark trees/archives. Only explicitly imported historical evidence under bundle/inputs/historical is included.

omitted_payloads_with_recorded_identitie.identity_basis: preserved selected build/snapshot receipt; omitted payload not rehashed by packaging
